missed_calls.transcript: The customer provided a script-critical objection ("I don't have any damage... I have a fairly new route") and the agent's very next response was "Okay" followed by a sign-off, making no attempt to rebut or pivot.
The customer provided a hard refusal ("No, I'm good. Thank you.") and the agent did not attempt any rebuttal or value statement before the call ended.

The customer provided a script-critical objection (NO_NEED_NO_ISSUES) by stating "I'm not going to do anything until it breaks." The agent's very next response was "Oh, gotcha. Okay, awesome," followed by a sign-off without any attempt to defend the value of the 10% discount or the benefit of proactive replacement.

The customer provided a script-critical objection ("I went in another direction"), and the agent's very next response was a submissive sign-off ("Sure. Have a great day. Bye bye") without any attempt to defend the value or pivot.

The customer raised a script-critical objection regarding price ("way out of the line on your price"), and the agent's immediate response was to ask if there was anything else and then sign off, making no attempt to defend the value or pivot.

The agent missed a rebuttal opportunity. When the customer stated they had already resolved the challenge (a script-critical objection), the agent's very next response was a sign-off ("Sure. Was there anything else...") followed by a goodbye, without any attempt to pivot or restate value.

The customer provided a "SPOUSE_DECISION_MAKER" objection, and the agent's very next response was a submissive compliance phrase ("Okay, gotcha... I can reach out to him then") followed by a goodbye, missing the opportunity to build value or ask a discovery question first.

The agent missed a critical rebuttal opportunity when the customer stated they already had a unit installed. Instead of pivoting to a maintenance or safety check, the agent immediately conceded with "I'll get this updated... Have a good day."

The customer raised a PRICE_CONCERN ("I have no money"), and the agent's very next response was "It's a free inspection," which is a restatement of value/price. However, the transcript ends there, and since the agent provided a restatement of value, this would normally be FALSE, but the instructions for TRUE require the agent's very next response to be a sign-off or goodbye. In this case, the agent did rebut, but if the call ended immediately after that without further attempt, it might be viewed as a miss if the agent didn't continue. Re-reading"Mark as FALSE if the agent made ANY of the following after the objectionAny restatement of value, price, or offer details." The agent said "It's a free inspection," which is a restatement of price/value. Therefore, it is FALSE.
